description: This file defines the 'Education' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, representing an educational qualification. It maps to the 'ohrm_education' database table and contains properties for id and name, along with a collection of related EmployeeEducation entities. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Entity\Education
classes.description: Entity class representing an education record in the database, with properties for id, name, and associated EmployeeEducation records.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the education record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the education record.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the education qualification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the education qualification.
